title_en: Malaysia, Thailand accelerate efforts to address Golok River flood
summary_en: KOTA BHARU: Malaysia and Thailand will step up cooperation to speed up efforts to address flood problems in the border area, particularly at the mouth of Golok River which is identified as a source of flooding in Kelantan and southern Thailand.
